overview: The Medford School Committee approved the annual performance evaluation for Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi, elected committee officers, and finalized subcommittee rosters. The committee also received detailed presentations on the Spring 2025 Youth Behavior Risk Survey and the proposed educational plan for the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Call to Order and Roll Call
items.summary: The meeting was called to order, the roll was called, and the committee recited the Pledge of Allegiance.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy with the Teamsters Local 25 custodians.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payrolls, budget transfers, grants, meeting minutes, and donations from Tufts University and the National Stuttering Association.

items.title: Youth Behavior Risk Survey Spring 2025
items.summary: Reviewed Spring 2025 Youth Behavior Risk Survey results presented by Catherine Dhingra and Dr. Stacey Schulman, highlighting local trends in student mental health, substance use, safety, and sports gambling.

items.title: Medford High School Building Project Educational Plan
items.summary: Received a presentation on the proposed Medford High School educational plan from Dr. Suzanne Galusi and Dr. Kim Talbot, with feedback requested by February 2nd ahead of a formal vote.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Evaluation and Goals Feedback
items.summary: Approved the compiled annual performance evaluation for Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi after a detailed overview of the standards and feedback categories presented by Member Aaron Olapade.

items.title: Election of School Committee Officers
items.summary: Elected Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn as Chair, Jenny Graham as Vice Chair, and Paul Ruseau as Secretary.

items.title: Resolution 2026-2: Representative to Shore Educational Collaborative
items.summary: Approved the appointment of Paul Ruseau as the representative to the Shore Educational Collaborative Board of Directors.

items.title: Resolution 2026-3: Subcommittee Chairs and Membership
items.summary: Approved the roster and chair designations for the committee's subcommittees for the upcoming term.

items.title: Resolution 2026-4: Strategic Planning Survey Leadership Data
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the strategic planning subcommittee chair to compile survey responses regarding district leadership priorities to inform the upcoming permanent superintendent vote.

items.title: Resolution 2026-5: Permanent Superintendent Process
items.summary: Approved a resolution setting February 2, 2026, as the meeting date to determine the approach for appointing a permanent superintendent and inviting public input.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: Expressed condolences to several local families and observed a moment of silence for deceased community members and school staff prior to adjournment.
